run_ping_cuberite: run the python module to ping a cuberite server on localhost port 25565
run_ping_custom_host: run the python module to ping a cuberite server on a custom host and port
test_ping_function: test the ping function by connecting to a cuberite server and verifying the pong response
review_ping_function: review the ping function that sends a handshake and ping packet over a socket connection
refactor_ping_timeout: refactor the ping function to support a configurable timeout value for socket connections
